League rules

RULES

Regular season

  • The Super League season has 27 rounds in this prototype, with one club receiving a bye in each round.
  • A win earns 2 league points; a draw earns 1; a loss earns 0. The table ranks clubs by points, then points difference.
  • Squad strength, player ratings, manager rating and fitness affect match results. IMG grade does not directly boost results.
  • Round 17 is Magic Weekend, using the scheduled rivalry fixtures and the season’s designated bye club.

Play-offs

  • The top six clubs qualify after the regular season. The top two receive a bye to the semi-finals.
  • Week 1: 3rd plays 6th and 4th plays 5th in the eliminators.
  • Week 2: 1st plays the lower-ranked surviving eliminator winner; 2nd plays the higher-ranked surviving winner.
  • The semi-final winners meet in the Grand Final at Old Trafford.

Magic Weekend

  • Magic Weekend is scheduled for Round 17 and uses the game’s designated rivalry pairings.
  • In Season 1, London Broncos receive the bye. In later seasons, the previous season’s bottom club receives the bye when applicable.

Championship & progression

  • The Championship has its own table and match records, separate from the Super League table.
  • Switching table views only changes what is displayed; it does not reset either competition’s points, results, or career progress.
  • Championship clubs can submit a £50,000 Super League application. Approval is simulated in this prototype and does not guarantee promotion.

IMG & funding

  • IMG grades and scores are shown as a management system. Grade A Super League clubs receive 100% of the prototype’s standard funding allocation; Grade B clubs receive 50%.
  • Facilities, finances, fanbase, on-field performance and squad strength influence club development and application assessment.
